## Linear issue
Link the issue, acceptance criteria and dependency decisions.

## Scope and changes
Summarize actual changed files and behavior. Note sensitive files, especially code, workflows, publishing, identities and AI instructions.

## Verification
- [ ] CI for the latest PR head commit passed
- [ ] Lint / typecheck / tests / build checked or failures explained
- [ ] Screenshots or preview attached when UI changes
- [ ] No unrelated files or unapproved publishing changes

## Review decision
- [ ] Requires explicit owner approval before merge (default)
- [ ] Eligible docs-only change (future capability; no automatic merge today)

Never treat a model-generated PASS as owner merge approval.
